title: Page 283
transc:
City Point Dec. 10 - 1864
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Us S Saugus pledge Spoons above black
Rosetta for Niagara unity wrangle just received
will start down at early delight whelp
Youth E. R Cole hound polkaer Sarah
S. H. Beckwith


Ft Monroe Dec. 10 - 1864
S. H. Beckwith City Point
Farmer Nancy for Jersey zebra Shelby pekin Your
wranglam is received I have heard nothing of
Shelter war in zodiac A panama rape will
start at day light sligo morning for the
sweden you desire . Please notify me when you 
hear of Shelby war wren yoke Respect fully
George F Shepley palsy polkaing another from Famish
Nancy for Judah zodiac Your second wranglam of
this date is received I shall make immediate
arrangements to plainfield with Shelby Warren yoke Shepley.
Geo. D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe Dec. 11 - 1864
S.H. Beckwith City Point. 
Katy for John Black zebra I have sent a
wolf to wards Hicksford also pebble Companies panama in
same direction also like salem of pacific and plank
vermin of nuptial to waxy Quay to hold pluming
of black water and tanner in direction of Harvey
zebra wales and Shade ready at moments notice toby
